Fill your quiet hours with real customers.

Founding locals

It is completely free during the test period. After the test you decide if you want to keep going. No commitment, no risk, simple.

Why Vorey

You're paying for attention, not customers.

Ads charge you for clicks and views from people who never show up. Review sites bury you unless you pay to climb. Your quiet hours stay quiet while the budget disappears. Vorey works the other way around: you pay only when a real customer walks in.

VOREY
Where to go, decided for you

Travel has a discovery problem.
We solve the decision.

The problem

People don't need more options. They need the answer.

Every app hands locals and travelers an endless list to scroll. Vorey gives one decision: the right place, right now, based on who you are and what's happening around you.

The market

A huge market, starting in one of its richest corners.

The Costa del Sol draws more than 14 million visitors and over 21 billion euros in tourism spend every year. Marbella sits at the luxury heart of it, dense with restaurants, beach clubs and the residents and expats who live here all year round.

14.6M
visitors a year
€21.8B
tourism spend
1
place, never a list of 200
The model

Free for users. Paid by merchants, only for results.

Vorey is free for everyone who uses it. Merchants pay around 1.50 euros for each verified real visit, confirmed by location. No clicks, no impressions, no wasted spend. Revenue grows directly with the real customers we deliver.

Where we are

Launching in Marbella, locals already on board.

We are building the product and launching in Marbella soon. Our first founding locals are already on board, from restaurants to a beach club, and a waitlist of residents is starting to form before we go live.
